import java.math.BigInteger;
import java.util.*;

    public static class Task {
        int mod = 998244353;
        int add(int a, int b) {
            int c = a + b;
            if (c >= mod) return c - mod;
            if (c < 0) return c + mod;
            return c;
        }
        int mult(int a, int b) {
            return (int) ((long) a * b % mod);
        }
        int mult(int... x) {
            int r = 1;
            for (int y : x) r = mult(r, y);
            return r;
        }
        int[][] stirling;
        void pre() {
            stirling = new int[5001][5001];
            for (int i = 0; i < stirling.length; i++) {
                stirling[i][0] = 0;
                stirling[0][1] = 0;
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < stirling.length; i++) stirling[i][i] = 1;
            for (int i = 2; i < stirling.length; i++) {
                for (int j = 1; j < i; j++) {
                    stirling[i][j] = add(mult(stirling[i - 1][j], i - 1), stirling[i - 1][j - 1]);
                }
            }
        }

        public void solve(Scanner sc, PrintWriter pw) throws IOException {
            pre();
            int n = sc.nextInt();
            int m = sc.nextInt();
            int k = sc.nextInt();
            int invm = BigInteger.valueOf(m).modInverse(BigInteger.valueOf(mod)).intValue();
            int[] pVal = new int[5001];
            pVal[0] = 1;
            int md = n;
            int prp = 1;
            for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
                prp = mult(prp, md, invm);
                md = add(md, -1);
                int sub = prp;
                for (int j = i - 1; j >= 1; j--) {
                    sub = add(sub, mult(stirling[i][j], ((i - j) % 2 == 1) ? pVal[j] : add(0, -pVal[j])));
                }
                pVal[i] = sub;
            }
            pw.println(pVal[k]);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(new BufferedOutputStream(System.out));
        Task t = new Task();
        t.solve(new Scanner(br), pw);
        pw.close();
    }

    static class Scanner {
        StringTokenizer st;
        BufferedReader br;
        public Scanner(BufferedReader br) { this.br = br; }
        public String next() throws IOException {
            while (st == null || !st.hasMoreTokens()) st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            return st.nextToken();
        }
        public int nextInt() throws IOException { return Integer.parseInt(next()); }

public class Main {

    static int add(int a, int b) {
        int c = a + b;
        if (c >= MOD) return c - MOD;
        if (c < 0) return c + MOD;
        return c;
    }
    static int mul(int a, int b) { return (int)((long)a * b % MOD); }
    static int mul(int... x) {
        int r = 1;
        for (int y : x) r = mul(r, y);
        return r;
    }

    // Extended Euclidean algorithm for modular inverse
    static int modInv(int a, int mod) {
        int t = 0, newt = 1;
        int r = mod, newr = a;
        while (newr != 0) {
            int q = r / newr;
            int temp = t - q * newt;
            t = newt;
            newt = temp;
            temp = r - q * newr;
            r = newr;
            newr = temp;
        }
        if (r > 1) throw new ArithmeticException("Not invertible");
        if (t < 0) t += mod;
        return t;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(new BufferedOutputStream(System.out));
        String[] parts = br.readLine().split(" ");
        int n = Integer.parseInt(parts[0]);
        int m = Integer.parseInt(parts[1]);
        int k = Integer.parseInt(parts[2]);
        int invm = modInv(m, MOD);

        // Precompute Stirling numbers using 2D array but only up to k
        int[][] stir = new int[k + 1][k + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
            stir[i][0] = 0;
            stir[i][i] = 1;
        }
        for (int i = 2; i <= k; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j < i; j++) {
                stir[i][j] = add(mul(stir[i - 1][j], i - 1), stir[i - 1][j - 1]);
            }
        }

        // Compute pVal using a different loop order: for each i, compute sum over j
        int[] pVal = new int[k + 1];
        pVal[0] = 1;
        int[] fall = new int[k + 1];
        fall[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
            fall[i] = mul(fall[i - 1], n - i + 1, invm);
            int sum = fall[i];
            for (int j = 1; j < i; j++) {
                int sign = ((i - j) % 2 == 1) ? 1 : -1;
                sum = add(sum, mul(stir[i][j], sign == 1 ? pVal[j] : add(0, -pVal[j])));

            pVal[i] = sum;
